sections.executive_summary: The assessment scoreboard (primary **ai_judgment_fair**, control **buy_tier_level**) shows the fair-cost AI book is not improving versus the market or the unfiltered buy tier: headline total return **-10.3%** vs **FTAL.L -0.2%** with **statistics.verdict "negative"** (32 marks, 90% CI), while control is **+0.85%** vs benchmark **+0.32%** with verdict **"indistinguishable_from_noise"** (29 marks). On the common window, **primary_vs_control.difference** is **-9.9%** (primary **-9.05%**, control **+0.85%**) — the accumulate/conviction gate did not add value over raw buy tier. Running twins **ai_judgment_matched30_fair** and **buy_tier_matched30_fair** each have **2** marks and **statistics.status "insufficient_data"** (one common day). The largest modelling gap this week is assessment calibration: **trajectory_evidence** has **labeled_event_count 1240** but **prediction_hit_rate_by_horizon** at **1w** is only **0.3578** (914 events), with **model_focus_candidates** flagging weak **hold→buy** and **1w** directional hits, aligned with **loser_snapshot_cards** **top_failed_families** **dividend (12)** and **garp (12)** on **88** cards. Exclusion ladder **u2** shows modest positive **cumulative_exclusion_alpha 0.0009** with **readiness.ready_for_priors true**, but paper primary remains deeply underwater — filters need offline proof before any live promotion.
sections.performance_diagnosis:
- **Primary vs market:** **ai_judgment_fair** **total_return -10.33%**, **benchmark_total_return -0.20%**, **excess_total_return -10.13%**; **statistics.verdict "negative"** with **annualized_active_return -1.19** — treat as real underperformance, not noise (32 marks).
- **Control vs market:** **buy_tier_level** **+0.85%** vs **+0.32%** benchmark; **verdict "indistinguishable_from_noise"** — slightly ahead of FTAL on this window but not statistically meaningful (29 marks).
- **Filter value:** Common-window **primary_vs_control.difference -9.9%** — AI filter destroyed value versus unfiltered buy tier on the overlapping period (not significance-tested in JSON).
- **Cost drag:** Primary **learning_tracks_review** shows **cost_drag 0.1386** (**£138.55** on 38 trades) and **excess_after_costs -0.1742**; control **cost_drag 0.0075** (**£7.51**, 115 trades) and **excess_after_costs -0.0007**. At **stress_cost_per_side 0.03**, scoreboard **excess_total_return_at_stress_cost** is **-29.36%** (primary) vs **-1.90%** (control).
- **Mark thickness:** Primary has enough marks for a **negative** verdict; control is thick enough for **indistinguishable** only. Twins and **buy_tier_level_dca** (**statistics.status "insufficient_data"**, 18 marks) are not verdict-ready. **learning_tracks_review.verdict** for the primary book is **"underperforming"** with **beat_market false** and **beat_control false** — do not promote knobs or policy on non-positive verdicts.
- **Active DCA realism track:** **buy_tier_level_dca** scoreboard **+2.07%** vs benchmark **+1.38%** but **insufficient_data** — context only, not fair-policy adoption per **paper_track_buckets** note.
sections.signal_backtest_findings:
- **Archived backtest** (**run_count 26**, seeded): at **28d**, **buy** **avg_return 0.0102**, **benchmark -0.0099**, **excess_return +0.0201** (n=776); at **7d**, **buy** **excess_return +0.0114** (from overlay_comparison). **insufficient_data** buckets are small and negative at both horizons.
- **Historical analysis / offline sim** (**run_count 26**): **7d** smoothed excess leaders include **overlay:strong_buy +0.0217** (200 obs, 11 weeks) and **overlay:hold +0.0075** (4065 obs); **research:accumulate** shows high raw return but **observation_weeks 1** only — still thin.
- **trajectory_evidence:** **labeled_event_count 1240**; hit rates **1w 0.3578**, **4w 0.4329**, **8w 0.4474**, **12w 0.4710**; **weeks_to_realization** **median_weeks 2**, **within_4w_rate 0.8038**, **realized_within_12w_rate 0.6606** (693/1049 scorable). **model_focus_candidates** (assessment hypotheses, not live-screen N3): **hold→buy 1w** (n=52, positive_rate 0.3654, mean -0.007124); **signal_unchanged 1w** (n=941); **strong_buy→buy** / **buy→strong_buy** weak 1w flips; **1w/4w horizon_hit_rate** below chance-like directional success.
- **loser_snapshot_cards:** **card_count 88**; **cohort_counts** **avoid 59**, **failed_buy_alumni 31**; **top_failed_families** **dividend 12**, **garp 12**, **cheapness 7**, **quality 5**, **risk 4**. Sample cards (e.g. **AMRQ.L**, **ANTO.L**) combine **dividend/garp** failures with **opinion_flip_triggers** such as “screen signal upgrades above avoid” and “passes dividend family (currently failed)”.
- **chart_outcome_review (observe-only):** **verdict "has_terrible"** — **66 terrible**, **4 stop_hit**, **245 well_timed** among **1226** charts; well-timed example **HEAD.L** (+100% return_since); weakest **LNZ.VI** (-52.81% terrible). Timing context only — not a knob source.
- **exclusion_universe:** **recommended_step** **u2** “Exclude avoid + timing wait”, **cumulative_exclusion_alpha 0.0009**, **positive_alpha_rate 0.4**, **avg_filtered_pool_size 58.24** (25 week_pairs); **readiness.ready_for_priors true**. Deeper conviction rungs (**u3–u4**) show negative cumulative alpha.

sections.proposed_experiments:
1. **[scoring] Offline family-weight stress on dividend/garp avoid cohort (AMRQ.L / ANTO.L-style opinion-flip + failed dividend/garp)** — quantify whether family gates would have kept the worst **88** loser-card names out of buy/accumulate paths without touching live assign_signal (human ack **ana-20260921-02**).
2. **[offline_sim] Assessment calibration for hold→buy and 1w directional hits (trajectory key hold→buy, n=52, hit_rate 1w=0.3578)** — test conviction/timing overlay weights that down-rank weak opinion flips before any paper knob (N3 hypothesis only).
3. **[offline_sim] Exclusion ladder step u2 replay on fair primary log (cumulative_exclusion_alpha 0.0009, 25 week_pairs, ready_for_priors true)** — cost-aware counterfactual vs actual **ai_judgment_fair**; human gate before **paper_knobs** shadow (not auto-apply).
4. **[paper_churn] Archive hold-vs-swap probability strand (exit_timing_near_miss: hold_closed 606, swap_closed 625; live primary 11/0)** — use archive priors per **exit_timing_reconciliation** (**archive_may_inform_priors_while_live_collects**); human ack **ana-20260921-04**; no live swap policy change.
5. **[monitoring] Cadence + adoption gate watch (entry_dca_overlay leading_cadence dca_4x_weekly, 217 closed; adoption stage out_of_sample_first_entry, acked)** — track first-entry counts on **ai_judgment_fair** / **buy_tier_level** until stage ready; observe-only, no DCA execution.

**DEFER (triggers):**

- **Auto-spawn exclusion shadow** — wait until **exclusion_ladder_replay.readiness.ready_for_shadow_spawn true** and human runs `ftse-exclusion-ladder-replay spawn-shadow`.
- **Live knob apply / decision-review --apply** — wait for **assessment_scoreboard** primary **verdict "positive"** and **significance_gate.passed true** on total-return vs FTAL.
- **Exclusion u2 / conviction rung auto-merge into primary** — defer until offline_sim u2 beats baseline with costs and paper human sign-off.
- **DCA execution on primary or new per-model DCA books** — defer until **entry_dca_adoption** stages **out_of_sample_first_entry** then **paper_execute_graduated** ready and **beat_market true**.
- **Chart_outcome / stop_hit-driven scoring experiments** — defer until **chart_outcome_review** used only as context alongside trajectory/loser forensics, not as knob triggers.
- **N58/N59 knob-retune or entry-timing probes** — remain cancelled; use open ledger tasks (**ana-20260921-02**, **ana-20260921-04**) instead of new ack wrappers.
